name: generate_media
description: Generate a media asset (image, video, or audio) from a text prompt and return a reference to the resulting file. Use this when the user asks to create, draw, render, or synthesize visual or audio content rather than describe it in words.

media_type.description: The kind of media to generate.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired output.

negative_prompt.description: Elements to avoid in the generated output.

format.description: Output file format. Must be compatible with media_type (e.g. png/jpeg/webp for image, mp4/webm for video, mp3/wav for audio).

width.description: Output width in pixels. Applies to image and video media_type only.

height.description: Output height in pixels. Applies to image and video media_type only.

duration_seconds.description: Output duration in seconds. Applies to video and audio media_type only.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random output.

quality.description: Quality/fidelity tier. Higher quality generally costs more and takes longer.

count.description: Number of variations to generate in one call.
